product_rank.scope: Small exact operator matrices and dimensional bottlenecks; no IMM trace lower bound or asymptotic circuit-size certification.

occupation_moments.scope: Uniform weak-composition factorial moments and geometric comparisons. A negative factorial coefficient reverses the upper comparison.

homogeneous_lookup.scope: Fixed finite-field lookup models; not the space-bounded evaluator or Turing-machine simulation.

top_coefficient.scope: Exact interpolation beyond the characteristic; not recursive word evaluation or a uniform field-construction space bound.

Gaussian_center_absorption.scope: Deterministic physical-query identity and Gaussian covariance, not an adaptive compiler accuracy theorem.

stationary_mean_flow.scope: Exact linear Gaussian flow via matrix exponentials; not general nonlinear transport-kernel estimates or implementable sampling.

finite_field_coefficient.scope: Finite multiplicative Fourier identity including no selected variables; does not verify counting-hierarchy closure levels.

residue_sign.scope: Residue-only recovery with a supplied product-size guarantee. The test harness stores the product solely to check results. No counting-hierarchy or prime-budget asymptotic certification.

limitations: Finite algebra and Gaussian examples do not certify the global complexity, circuit, machine-simulation or sampling claims.
